name: side-panel
title: Side Panel
description: A non-modal inspector beside a list: a named complementary region, Escape closes it and returns focus to the row, and shortcuts declared inside run while it is open.
docs: `<SidePanel open onOpenChange title description actions returnFocus>` renders nothing while closed. Lay it out beside the list in a flex row (`--side-panel-width`, 24rem by default); on narrow screens it covers its positioned parent. Escape anywhere on the page closes it (a modal above it gets Escape first), and focus that was inside it, or lost to the body, moves to `returnFocus()`. It is a `ShortcutScope` that is active while open (`scope`, `scopeLabel` for the `ShortcutsDialog`), so `Button shortcut="u"` inside it works while focus stays in the list. `labels={{ close }}` names the close button.
